prompt:
ROLE/PURPOSE: player character seed asset for a fixed top-down arena game, drawn in the Q-style / super-deformed chibi register. This is the single approved visual target the whole cast is rebuilt from.

PROPORTION - THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT. Super-deformed Q-style: the character is only about TWO AND A HALF HEADS TALL. The head is enormous, roughly 45 percent of the entire figure height. The body is a short, stubby, rounded little torso. Arms and legs are short and thick, like a plush toy, and the hands and feet are oversized. Absolutely no realistic or tall proportions: if the figure looks like a normal person with a big head, it is wrong. Think of a collectible chibi figurine or an SD mascot character.

SUBJECT: a tiny chibi apprentice mage standing in a neutral idle pose, holding an oversized staff in one hand, feet together on the ground.

FACE: huge round expressive eyes with big highlights, taking up most of the face; a tiny dot or line for a nose; a small cheerful closed smile. Blonde fringe visible under the hood.

VIEW: fixed three-quarter view from above (camera roughly 55 degrees above the horizon), body facing the viewer, upright, symmetrical, no lean, no motion.

ART DIRECTION: bright Q-style anime. VERY THICK bold dark ink outline, roughly 4px at this resolution, around the whole silhouette and around the major internal shape breaks. Flat 2-tone cel shading only, a hard terminator between light and shadow, one key light from the upper-left, cool ambient fill. Saturated royal blue and white robe with gold trim. The hood is oversized, rounded and slightly floppy, much bigger than the head. The staff is taller than the character and ends in a bright glowing cyan crystal.

GAME-SCALE READ: the whole figure is drawn only 73 pixels tall on screen, so at that size the head, the huge eyes, the rounded hood, the staff and its crystal above the shoulder line must each still read as separate shapes.

TECHNICAL OUTPUT: square, TRANSPARENT background (real alpha channel), single isolated figure, centred, small even margin on all four sides, whole body inside the frame including feet.

LOCKS: Q-style chibi proportions, three-quarter top-down camera, blue / white / gold palette, thick ink outline weight, upper-left key light.

EXCLUDE: realistic or tall proportions, long legs, a small head, adult body proportions, cast shadows on the ground, ground plane, scenery, props, second characters, text, labels, UI, frames, watermark, signature, cropped or cut-off limbs, motion blur, dramatic pose.
